messages:
eva: Quick heads-up — Acme wants to add a subsidiary (for tax/regulatory reasons) as an additional signing party on the order form and wants an AML/sanctions screening clause in the MSA. They also asked for 2 signers on the order form (legal + finance). Any must-stop issues?

mike_legal: Not a blocker. We can accomodate via an addendum that lists the subsidiary entity and limits AML obligations to transaction-level screening. Avoid open-ended representations. Need exact legal name + tax id to include. Also: prefer the order form to reference the MSA addendum rather than try to rewrite core MSA.

sara_procurement: Finance will not provision seats without a PO attached. Can we add a field on the order form: `PO required: yes` and route final invoice to their AP email? Also need billing contact and remit address.

josh_eng: Important: for Dedicated POC we can't expose infra endpoints or VPN creds until the DPA that covers the new entity is signed. So DPA + addendum = gating item for provisioning.

mike_legal: Agreed. I'll prepare a short addendum + DPA amendment. Proposal: addendum enumerates entities (parent + subsidiary) and clarifies signature mechanics. DPA amendment will mirror entity list for data processing scope.

anna_cust_success: Customer prefers DocuSign but their internal procurement asked for an HSM-backed audit trail afterwards. Do we have a path to swap signature mechanism later?

liam_security: We can support HSM-backed signing for Dedicated/Private customers (enterprise add-on with attestation). For hosted customers we provide standard audit logs and SOC2. Transitioning signature method post-signature is OK if contract includes a clause stating mutual written agreement required to change method.

eva: They're greenlit for a Dedicated POC in us-west and want to start provisioning early next week. Execs want signatures today if possible. Could we do DocuSign now and amend later?

mike_legal: DocuSign now, with a narrowly scoped amendment later, sounds fine. I'll add language: "Interim signature method: DocuSign accepted; parties may replace with HSM-backed signature process upon mutual written confirmation."

sara_procurement: On payment terms — Acme asked for Net45. Finance prefers Net30. We could offer Net45 with a 2% early payment discount if they do Net30. Any objections?

eva: sounds workable. I'll float that to the buyer.

josh_eng: To reiterate the technical gating: we need a signed DPA that lists both entities before handing over any VPN/SSH/console access. Can legal fast-track the DPA?

mike_legal: I'll mark DPA as high priority and aim to circulate initial drafts within the day. Need the confirmed legal entity strings and tax id from Acme to populate.

anna_cust_success: Pinged Acme for entity + EIN and billing contact. Will post reply in this thread.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: envelope_id=env-9f8e7d waiting on signatures (order-form-acme).

anna_cust_success: Acme replied: "Acme Industrial Holdings, Inc." EIN 12-3456789. Billing contact: ap@acme.example.com / Remit: 100 Industrial Way, Suite 200, Springfield, CA.

mike_legal: Thanks. Drafting addendum now. I'll include this PO snippet for procurement: `Billing contact: ap@acme.example.com; PO required; Remit address included; Net30 standard unless Net45 agreed in writing`. tagging @sara_procurement for confirmation.

sara_procurement: Confirmed. Please include `PO required` field and route final invoice to ap@acme.example.com. We'll accept Net45 only if finance signs off on credit terms; otherwise Net30 with 2% early pay credit to customer.

eva: Plan: hold POC provisioning until signed order form + DPA. We can start a preflight checklist internally once Mike posts the addendum draft. Thanks everyone.

mike_legal: Draft will be in PR in ~90 minutes. I'll post a link here for review.

anna_cust_success: FYI Acme asked if signatures can be split (legal signs in their EU entity, finance signs at US parent). Is cross-entity signing OK?

mike_legal: It's fine as long as the addendum explicitly lists which entity is signing which piece and ties them to the same commercial arrangement. I'll add a clause mapping signing entities to invoice and data processing roles.

eva: Great. Closing checklist: 1) addendum + DPA draft (mike) 2) PO field + billing contact confirmed (sara) 3) interim DocuSign envelope (esign-bot) 4) confirm net terms with finance (eva) 5) provisioning hold until signed (josh).

esign-bot: envelope env-9f8e7d updated: legal signer completed. awaiting finance signer.
